about: Top-level fields: manifest_version is 1, the plugin id is lower-case reverse-DNS (^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)+$, 3 to 64 characters, its first part not a Windows device name), min_vizi is a PEP 440 version and sdk_version a non-empty string, both optional. Read by the Go, Rust and Java parsers' tests and by scripts/check_manifest_fixtures.py; expected.kind is 'invalid' (the message contains expected.message) or 'accepted'.

cases.name: a reverse-DNS id with digits and underscores is accepted
the shortest id is three characters
the longest id is 64 characters
an id with upper case is refused

expected.message: id 'org.Example.tool' is not a plugin id

cases.name: an id without a dot is refused

expected.message: id 'exampletool' is not a plugin id

cases.name: an id of 65 characters is refused
an id with a leading digit is refused

expected.message: id '1org.example' is not a plugin id

cases.name: an id with a double dot is refused

expected.message: id 'org..example' is not a plugin id

cases.name: an id whose first part has an underscore is refused

expected.message: id 'my_org.example' is not a plugin id

cases.name: an id whose first part is a Windows device name is refused

expected.message: id 'con.example' is not a plugin id: its first part 'con' is a Windows device name

cases.name: an id whose first part is a numbered Windows device name is refused

expected.message: id 'lpt1.tool' is not a plugin id: its first part 'lpt1' is a Windows device name

cases.name: an id whose first part is a Windows device name in upper case is refused

expected.message: id 'LPT1.tool' is not a plugin id: its first part 'LPT1' is a Windows device name

cases.name: an id whose first part is com9 is refused

expected.message: id 'com9.plugin' is not a plugin id: its first part 'com9' is a Windows device name

cases.name: an id whose first part is com0 is refused

expected.message: id 'com0.plugin' is not a plugin id: its first part 'com0' is a Windows device name

cases.name: an id whose first part is lpt0 is refused

expected.message: id 'lpt0.plugin' is not a plugin id: its first part 'lpt0' is a Windows device name

cases.name: an id whose first part only begins with a device name is accepted
an id whose first part is com10 is accepted
an id with a device name as a later part is accepted
min_vizi and sdk_version are accepted in their forms
a pre-release, post-release and dev min_vizi is accepted
a min_vizi that is not a PEP 440 version is refused

expected.message: min_vizi 'v0.9' is not a PEP 440 version

cases.name: a min_vizi that is not a string is refused
an empty sdk_version is refused

expected.message: sdk_version must be a non-empty string

cases.name: an sdk_version that is not a string is refused

expected.message: sdk_version must be a non-empty string

cases.name: manifest_version 0 is refused
manifest_version 0 is refused for itself, not for a field it lacked
manifest_version true is refused: a boolean is not the integer 1
